title: A Human-Inspired Reading Agent with Gist Memory

defines.name: ReadAgent
defines.definition: An LLM agent system that reads long inputs by segmenting them into episodes, compressing episodes into gist memories, and interactively looking up relevant original passages when needed.

problem: LLMs have limited context windows and their performance degrades on long inputs, making them unable to robustly consume and reason over very long documents.
